name: Rotating Words For WPBakery Page Builder
author: Labib Ahmed

sections.description:
Rotating Words – Addon for WPBakery is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin that lets you rotate words or phrases in a sentence with stylish animations. It’s designed exclusively for WPBakery Page Builder, allowing you to easily insert animated text anywhere on your site.

🔥 Features:

  • Full integration with WPBakery Page Builder
  • Rotate custom words or phrases within a sentence
  • Smooth animation effects (fade, slide, typewriter, zoom, etc.)
  • Customizable speed, timing, and style
  • Mobile responsive and performance optimized
  • Beginner-friendly – no coding required

Perfect for creating dynamic headlines, banners, and calls to action that capture your visitors’ attention.

Note: This plugin requires WPBakery Page Builder Plugin.

Live DEMO
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rotating-words-addon-for-wpbakery directory, or install it via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open WPBakery Page Builder and use the Rotating Words element in your layout.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work only with WPBakery?

Yes, this addon is built specifically for WPBakery Page Builder.

Can I customize animation speed and style?

Yes, animation speed, delay, and type can be fully customized from the WPBakery element settings.
